comment: Generated by tools/build-icbm-cortex.mjs. Do not edit; rebuild.
First-party lobe labels for the ICBM152 2009c cortex. Drawn by us from standard anatomical landmarks placed on the ICBM152 surface; no parcellation was used to draw them.
vertexLabels[structure id] has one character per vertex of that structure in the geometry file, in vertex order: the label value, 0 for not cortex (the medial wall and the cut faces).
space: MNI152 2009c asymmetric millimetres, RAS (the geometry's own space)

conventions.limbic: cingulate gyrus and isthmus; the parahippocampal gyrus is labelled temporal (the brief names the cingulate sulcus as the limbic landmark, and no collateral sulcus)
conventions.insula: inside the circular sulcus, placed as the border of the insular floor: laterally facing cortex deeper than 12 mm in the lateral fissure
conventions.paracentral: the central sulcus is carried over the dorsal margin to the cingulate sulcus by a line, which splits the paracentral lobule between frontal and parietal
conventions.calcarine: inside the occipital lobe; not a boundary

precision.boundaries: unstated: no independent measurement of where a lobe boundary truly lies exists for this template

insula.placement: largest connected set of vertices deeper than 12 mm with |n_x| >= 0.6 (facing laterally) in |x| 25-45, y -40..35, z -25..30, holes filled; its border is the circular sulcus
